for c in sorted(s_row.keys()):

    print(f"  Pos {c}: S={s_row[c][:8]}... P={p_row.get(c, 'N/A')[:8] if p_row.get(c) else 'N/A'}... {match}")

# Now cycle P-row at position 15 to see all options
# Current cursor is at 43, need to move to 15
# 43 -> 36 -> 29 -> 22 -> 15 (4 LEFTs)
result = action(['LEFT', 'LEFT', 'LEFT', 'LEFT'])

# Record current P-row hash at pos 15
current_hash = None
for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] >= 10:
        b = n['boundary']
        r = min(p[0] for p in b)
        c = min(p[1] for p in b)
        if r == 52 and c == 15:
            current_hash = n['hash']
            break

print(f"\nStarting P-row pos 15 hash: {current_hash}")

# Cycle through all options

for i in range(20):  # max 20 cycles to avoid infinite loop
    result = action(['UP'])

    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] >= 10:
            b = n['boundary']
            r = min(p[0] for p in b)
            c = min(p[1] for p in b)
            if r == 52 and c == 15:
                new_hash = n['hash']
                break
    hashes_seen.append(new_hash)
    if new_hash in hashes_seen[:-1]:
        break

print(f"All P-row pos 15 options ({len(hashes_seen)-1} unique): {[h[:8] for h in hashes_seen[:-1]]}")

# Check which match S-row at pos 15
s_hash_15 = s_row[15]
matches = [h for h in hashes_seen[:-1] if h == s_hash_15]
print(f"S-row pos 15 hash: {s_hash_15[:8]}...")
print(f"Matches: {len(matches)}")

# Also check which match upper grid
upper_hashes = set()
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] >= 10:
        b = n['boundary']
        r = min(p[0] for p in b)
